Name: Nyapu inspired Popuri - for Farmer Portraits - WIP
Author: shivacrystalrain
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Original Nyapu portraits can be found here[/url] — my images are a fan-made interpretation of their style, featuring the character Popuri from [i]Harvest Moon[/i].

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 

[b]About:
[/b]I made some Popuri replacement portraits for the Farmer Portraits mod—originally just for my own playthrough, but I figured I might as well share them.
I tried to match Nyapu’s style, since I’m also using all of their villager portraits and wanted everything to feel cohesive in-game. For the base, I used Nyapu’s Haley portrait, and the beach hat Popuri wears is from Lunna.

I’ll try to continue and add more festival portraits in the future. If you have specific wishes or ideas, let me know :)

[b]Please note that this is still a work in progress. The colors and outfits may change over time as I continue refining the look and exploring the available clothing options in Fashion Sense.[/b]

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 

[b]Installation:[/b]
Replace the PNG files inside the "Farmer Portrait Mod/assets" folder with the provided files.

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

[/b]No sprites are included. Please use Fashion Sense along with the mods listed here on Nexus to customize your character. You can find the exact items I use in the article [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4181]HERE[/url]
